import pytest
import tomlkit
from tomlkit.exceptions import TOMLKitError


def test_nesting_table_in_inlinetable_raises_error() -> None:
    t = tomlkit.table()
    t.append("a", 1)

    it = tomlkit.inline_table()

    with pytest.raises(TOMLKitError, match="Inline tables cannot contain tables"):
        it.append("table", t)
